北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友们，天寒地冻，体感 -11℃，请务必多穿衣，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's freezing, feels like -11℃. Please dress warmly and stay safe!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，气温 0℃，注意交通安全，出行慢一点哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has fog, temperature is 0℃. Please drive carefully and take your time.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾，气温 3℃，能见度低，出行注意安全哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy, temperature 3℃ with low visibility. Travel safely.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州朋友，虽晴朗，体感 1℃ 还是凉，添衣防寒很重要。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou friends, it's clear but feels like 1℃. Adding layers is key to staying warm.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，体感 5℃，北风轻拂，早晚添衣才不会着凉。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is clear, feels like 5℃ with a north wind. Add clothes morning/evening to avoid catching a cold.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 0℃，虽然无风，还是要注意防寒保暖哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is clear, feels like 0℃. Although it's not windy, remember to keep warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，体感 -4℃，路滑能见度低，出行小心慢行。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy, feels like -4℃. Roads are slippery with low visibility, so be careful.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，湿度 100%，体感微凉，记得防潮保暖哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 100% humidity. It feels a bit chilly, remember to stay dry and warm.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度不高，体感 -3℃，出行注意安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with low visibility, feels like -3℃. Please travel safely.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 -4℃，湿冷感强，注意多穿防寒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear, feels like -4℃, very damp and cold. Remember to dress warmly.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 2℃，湿气重，出行请务必注意安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, feels like 2℃ with high humidity. Please travel safely.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -27℃，请严密防寒，做好万全准备！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -27℃. Please take full precautions to stay warm!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -27℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -25℃，寒风刺骨，出门记得全副武装。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear, feels like -25℃. It's biting cold, remember to bundle up completely!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 -1℃，阵阵北风，请注意添衣防寒哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast, feels like -1℃ with gusty north winds. Please remember to add layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 3℃，北风阵阵，出门别忘了带外套。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 3℃ with north gusts. Don't forget your jacket when you go out.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -5℃，风力 3 级，海边风大，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -5℃ with a force 3 wind. It's windy by the sea, keep warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -10℃，风力 2 级，海风凛冽，注意防寒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -10℃ with a force 2 wind. The sea wind is piercing, keep warm.
